Agorapulse is a general-purpose social media scheduling and inbox management tool. Starting at $79/user/month on the annual plan, you get publishing, scheduling, a unified inbox, and reporting. Its AI drafts captions and its Archie tool repurposes content you already have, but you still shoot the videos and design the graphics. There are no real estate templates, no local market content, and no industry-specific features. Per-user pricing means costs scale fast for teams.
